title: Systems: The Microenvironment & Invasion Fronts
description: No anomaly grows alone. It recruits blood vessels and stroma, signals to the cells around it, and invades as a travelling front whose speed is set by how fast it grows and how far it diffuses - the same mathematics as a cellular automaton spreading on a grid. Unlocks the Tumour Microenvironment Organoid.

puzzle.goal: Anomalous cells of density u diffuse through tissue with diffusivity D and divide at a rate r while there is room, up to a carrying density K. Write how the density changes in space and time: diffusion plus self-limiting growth.
puzzle.name: Fisher–KPP reaction–diffusion equation (a travelling invasion front)
puzzle.form: D * lap ( u ) + r * u * ( 1 - u / K )
puzzle.ask: Started from a small seed, the anomaly invades as a front that settles to the speed c = 2√(Dr). With D in mm²/day and r per day, find the speed of the front in mm/day.
puzzle.method: Linearise at the leading edge (u small) and look for a front u ∝ e^{−λ(x − ct)}: c = Dλ + r/λ, smallest at λ = √(r/D).
